summary: REQ-1 appears to be implemented by setting Total Capital to 327.0 in backend performance metrics and (per the HomePage summary) rendering Total Capital as $327.00 on the public Home page. However, the diff also introduces a new backend metrics field and migration scaffolding, which were not requested and may violate the stated non-goals.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a new `totalCapital` field to the backend `PerformanceMetrics` type (introducing a new metrics field rather than only changing an existing displayed value).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest non-goals explicitly say not to add new metrics fields; the change requests only updating the displayed value for the existing Total Capital tile.

hallucinated_features.description: Added migration scaffolding and wired it into the backend actor (`migration.mo` and `with migration = Migration.run`).
hallucinated_features.reason: No migration-related work is requested by REQ-1; requirement is a UI display value change for a specific tile.
